title: SourceReference v0.1
description: Frozen reusable provenance reference for QA and hallucination review.
$comment: The frozen SourceReference is a small human-readable building block for later planning-contract composition. Standards-compliant Ajv/runtime validation is deferred to T0111.

source.description: Nonblank human-readable identifier for the supplied source; its value distinguishes supplied documents without adding a document-ID field.

page.description: Optional human-visible one-based page number for supporting material. A SourceReference covers one page; page ranges are unsupported.

section.description: Optional nonblank human-readable section or heading locator for supporting material.

text.description: Optional nonblank source-grounded supporting excerpt for QA and hallucination review, rather than a planner paraphrase, interpretation, or summary; the schema cannot prove grounding.
